protocol: v9 duration-aware FBCCA, frozen candidate set and untouched BETA confirmation
train_data: none; analytic CCA, no fitted parameters
confirmation_rule: S1..S70 excluding v2 subject roles, v5 new test, v6 additional train/new test, v7 new test and v8 new test; SHA256(v9-duration-fbcca:filename) ascending first 5
processing: crop first, zero-phase Butterworth 6-90 Hz, per-channel standardization, unchanged 3-subband 3-harmonic FBCCA
selection: highest BETA development subject-macro accuracy; ties in listed candidate order, requiring >=2 percentage points gain over first_1p5; otherwise baseline
promotion: on fresh BETA confirmation, selected candidate needs >=2 percentage points macro gain and >=4/5 subjects non-negative versus baseline; otherwise baseline default
competition_data: D1/D2 are historically exposed verification only; never used for fitting, candidate choice, threshold selection or promotion
